Class User

java.lang.Object
app.User
public class User extends Object
Represents the player user and controls player movement, animation, stats, and room transitions.

This class connects keyboard input, updates the player through an animation timer, checks room collisions, and manages returning to the main hallway scene.

    • resume

      public void resume(javafx.scene.Scene scene)
      Resumes the user in the given scene.

      This method stops movement, resets the player position, starts the animation timer, allows room entry again, resets the room transitioner, and requests focus for keyboard input.

      Parameters:
      scene - the scene where the user resumes movement

    • connect

      public void connect(javafx.scene.Scene scene)
      Connects the user controls and animation timer to the given scene.

      This method sets up keyboard input, movement control, animation updates, room transition checks, and player canvas position updates.

      Parameters:
      scene - the scene that receives keyboard input and updates

    • changeStats

      public boolean changeStats(int optionType)
      Changes the user's stats based on the selected dialogue option.

      This method updates the player's social battery and social standing, refreshes the stats bars, and returns whether the game should end.

      Parameters:
      optionType - the selected dialogue option number
      Returns:
      true if the stat change causes a game-over condition, false otherwise
